inspectionMethod: Direct pixel inspection of all 16 PNG captures after the final correction run

correctedDefects.symptom: The off-screen skip link was projected into Playwright full-page screenshots after keyboard activation.
correctedDefects.rootCause: The classic negative-top skip-link technique remained inside the full-page projection surface.
correctedDefects.correction: Keep the link visibility hidden until :focus-visible while preserving keyboard reachability.

correctedDefects.symptom: Embedded dashboard tabs were visually presented but did not update aria-pressed state.
correctedDefects.correction: Add native button interaction and live-region readback without routing assistant actions through DOM control.

nonclaims: The screenshots use a faithful embedded shell, not a live Superset runtime.
